apps.name: ParkBud
apps.subtitle: Street-cleaning parking reminders for your block
apps.localizedDescription:
ParkBud looks up your street-cleaning schedule from an address and tells you which side of the street to park on. Pick your car, follow light or dark mode, track maintenance, and add the Lock Screen widget or Apple Watch complication.

This listing is build 9 of ParkBud 1.0. SideStore will re-sign the IPA with your Apple ID before install. Refresh about every 7 days if you use a free developer account. Widget, Watch, and App Group extras may not survive every signing setup; the iPhone app is the install target.

permissions.usageDescription: ParkBud uses your location when you park to work out which side of the street your car is on and when that side is swept.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 9: current ParkBud with car picker, light/dark mode, maintenance reminders, Lock Screen widget, and Apple Watch.
